# TH1.0 to TH1.1 horizon mapping (generated by `suite_mapping.py`)

Declared in `suite_mapping.yaml` (`SUITE-MAP-TH10-TH11`). A descriptive calibration over 16 agents with published post-correction values on both suites (14 fit, 2 held out). ln(h11) = a + b ln(h10), minutes of human time, one fit per metric. 90% prediction intervals are Student t. Not empirical validation; the criteria were fixed after an exploratory look at the same pairs.

## P50

- Fit (14 agents): a = -1.323, b = 1.316 (se 0.042; bootstrap 95% interval 1.24 to 1.41), residual sd 0.183 in ln units (a factor of 1.20), R^2 0.988.
- All 16 in the fit (sensitivity): a = -1.184, b = 1.286, residual sd 0.193.
- Support (fit-set TH1.0 horizons): 7.1 to 246.8 minutes. The mapping is not applied outside it.
- Published intervals as ln standard errors: median 0.34 (TH1.0) and 0.31 (TH1.1); if the two errors were independent the difference would scatter by 0.48, against a residual sd of 0.18 about the line. Independent errors could not give a scatter that small, so the two suites' sampling errors are positively correlated (shared tasks and families); the published files cannot say by how much, and a paired bootstrap was not run.
- Residual by lab (mean ln, informational): anthropic -0.06 (n=7), openai +0.06 (n=7).

|---|---|
